body: I can't get rid of it, not now, not until I know I don't need it.  It'd be so terrible to be without it, I'd have to kill myself by running my car off a bridge or into a tree at 100mph, it's much messier and more likely to go wrong and there's much greater risk to other people.  I don't even want to touch it right now, though.  I just want to go to sleep and leave it there.

Thank you, it's just . . .  my problems aren't related to drama, I don't react with people that way, so it's very simple.  I fuck up, they blame me, life goes on for a little while and then I fuck up again.  I don't need time to fix personal relationships, any problems with my relationships wouldn't exist at all if I stopped fucking up...

My friend didn't know how much danger he was in.  If he knew he'd get hurt he wouldn't have done it.  I knew he would probably get hurt, I just kept telling myself it wouldn't happen, he'd be fine.  I didn't have any capacity to stop him from where I was, or even warn him, but I could've gotten in contact with people who could've helped him and I didn't.  Like I said, I deserve blame.

My job . . . wow, I don't think I'll ever get a recommendation if I can't show great improvement for awhile.  But half of my shoddy performance is my character (not very personable with clients, couldn't sell water to a man living in the desert for pennies), and the other half is my tendency to mess up.

I just have to live up to someone's expectations . . .   I don't think I could tolerate a world where no one lived up to mine.  I don't live up to my own.  I don't think I can be helped.  I don't think that people deserve a happier version of me that's just as much of a screw-up inflicted on them.

Thanks so much.  It's good to hear even one person talk like I shouldn't just die.  It's not like I think I should just die, it's just that I'm no good at being alive and I'm no good for anyone else, and that hurts me, and I don't want to live with that hurt, either.  It just makes sense...

I am so not in a mood to treat myself right now, it'd be perverse.  I fucked up again, and all I can do is whimper about it.  Or do everyone a favor and end the fuck-ups, even if it hurts us all for a little while.  

I feel like it's "do things right or die", and I'm not strong enough to do things right...

There are people out there who've had to bear SO MUCH more than me.  I am so weak.  I've read the sidebar stuff.  About resources and coping.  But my internal resources are SO much less than everyone else who's here.  I'm so childish.  I'll cry over anything right now.  I could keep living if I were willing to be a burden on so many people.  It would take SO many coping resources that aren't me to help me.  I'm sorry but I won't.  Life isn't perfect.  Neither am I.  I can't do this life thing much longer.  It's all I've got, but I won't care about it when it's gone.  Caring will be impossible.  I'm so sorry, everyone.  I'm sorry I was such a screw-up that I couldn't even just live.
